title: AGENT_PERFORMANCE_ASSIGNMENT_V1
description: JSON schema for Observe.ai bulk S3 export of agent performance assignment records. Each file is gzip-compressed JSON (AGENT_PERFORMANCE_ASSIGNMENT_V1_<timestamp>.json.gz). Each record is one JSON object.

assignment_configuration_id.description: Identifier of the parent assignment configuration.

start_time.description: UTC timestamp when the record/session started.

end_time.description: UTC timestamp when the record/session ended.

evaluatorId.description: Evaluator identifier assigned to the interaction.

evaluationId.description: Evaluation identifier once evaluated, else null.

items.description: One interaction included in the assignment.

_id.description: User identifier associated with the meeting count entry.

meetingCount.description: Number of meetings counted for the corresponding user identifier.

items.description: Meeting count entry for one agent.

agent_meeting_count_filters.description: Filter criteria used to select agent interaction counts for the assignment. Filter rules applied when counting interactions for this assignment.

_id.description: User identifier associated with the meeting count entry.

meetingCount.description: Number of meetings counted for the corresponding user identifier.

items.description: Meeting count entry for one evaluator.

evaluator_meeting_count_filters.description: Filter criteria used to select evaluator interaction counts for the assignment. Filter rules applied when counting interactions for this assignment.

created_by_user_id.description: Identifier of the user who created the assignment.

assignment_progress.description: Overall completion progress of the assignment (0-1 or %).

progress.description: Percentage of assigned meetings evaluated by this evaluator (0-100).

evaluator_progress.description: Per-evaluator completion progress for this assignment. Exported as 0.0 when no evaluators are assigned.

evaluation_template_id.description: Identifier of the evaluation template used for this assignment.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was created.

modified_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was last modified.
